general: Implement a strict 'Dark Mode Only' policy. Do not create light mode styles.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ALL numerical data (prices, P&L, volume). This is non-negotiable for a trading app.
Ensure all P&L numbers are colored: Green (#00E599) for positive, Red (#FF1A40) for negative.
Use the 'Control Room' grid layout. Avoid large empty spaces. This is a data-dense application.
For the 'Stock Scanner', use a dense table layout with sticky headers.
For the 'Chart View', ensure the chart library (Recharts) container takes up the remaining height of the screen (flex-1).
Add a 'Paper Trading' vs 'Live Trading' toggle in the header that switches the global context/badge.

specific_pages.dashboard: Layout: 3-column grid. Left: Account Summary (Vertical). Center: Active Chart (Wide). Right: Watchlist/Scanner (Vertical List).
specific_pages.scanner: Full-width data table. Filters on top (horizontal bar). Results below. Row click opens chart.
specific_pages.active_trades: Card-based layout for mobile, Table for desktop. Show 'Unrealized P&L' prominently.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid dark colors with subtle borders.
Avoid rounded corners > 4px. Keep it sharp and technical.
All interactive elements must have a hover state (brightness-110 or border color change).
Use 'sonner' for all trade notifications (Order Filled, Stop Loss Hit).
